description.value: Oya is a fusion Japanese cuisine restaurant housed inside the Hearthstone Lodge Building at Sun Peaks Resort, a year-round mountain destination popular with skiers and mountain bikers. The kitchen rotates its menu regularly and offers a diverse sake selection, aiming to give returning guests something new each visit. Its compact resort-village location makes it one of the primary sit-down dining options within easy reach of the Sun Peaks resort core.
